tasks.description: Create index.html: a static, dependency-free playground importing { run, format, WeftError } from ./src/index.mjs via <script type="module">, with a source textarea, Run and Format buttons, and output showing printed output, the final value, and WeftError positions. No external network references. Must satisfy scripts/check_playground.mjs (read it).

Write examples/fizzbuzz.weft (recursion+print), examples/pipeline.weft (map/filter/reduce then print), examples/strings.weft (string builtins), and tests/golden.test.mjs which run()s each (node:fs) and asserts the COMPLETE expected output. Follow docs/DESIGN.md exactly.
